name: Stronger than Steel
summary: At Gloomrise, a researcher seeks crystalline silk from the spreading giant spiders. The silk may yield a light cloth with strong defenses.

sections.title: Silk for Study
sections.body: A researcher asks you for more crystalline silk after a scout returned from Gloomrise covered in it. Giant spiders have spread across the burial ground, and their venom is rumored to wake the dead. The silk's resilience may make it useful for cloth with defensive strength.

sections.title: A New Weave
sections.body: The samples prove sufficient for the researcher's needs. A cloak woven from silk already on hand is offered to you, with hopes it will aid your travels.

faq.answer: The researcher wants more crystalline silk from the Gloomrise spiders for study.
The crystalline silk comes from giant spiders at Gloomrise.
The silk may be made into lightweight, durable cloth with defensive properties.

faq.q: What is rumored about the spiders' venom?
faq.answer: The spiders' venom is rumored to be strong enough to wake the dead.

faq.q: What did the scout bring back?
faq.answer: One scout returned from investigating Gloomrise covered in resilient, crystalline spider silk.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stronger than Steel
